name: BAE Systems RG-32M
armament: Roof ring mount or RWS for a 7.62 mm GPMG or 12.7 mm HMG
protection: Monocoque armoured steel hull with V-shaped underside; real-world protection against rifle fire and small anti-tank mines. Game: immune to small-calibre rounds; 7.62x54R AP and larger can penetrate the sides and glass; every launcher in the game list penetrates.
visual_notes: Compact 4x4 armoured SUV with a sloped bonnet and slab-sided monocoque body
Large flat armoured windscreen in two panes; small thick side windows
Single rear door with spare wheel; roof hatch with weapon ring
Irish vehicles in olive drab at home and UN white with black 'UN' on overseas tours
variants: RG-32M LTV (Patria/BAE light tactical vehicle, Finland)
